verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Feature Gates toggle product behavior in real time without deploying code and act as an emergency kill switch in production. A first-feature tutorial walks through creating a gate and checking it live with the JavaScript SDK, and feature flags are included in the free tier, which supports quick self-serve onboarding. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the signup-to-first-flag time (the 'within minutes' claim is only implied by the tutorial), and independent hands-on corroboration of how fast onboarding actually is.
